name: Gate-date authority
rule: Any action that moves a gate date must be decided by a human.

name: Spend authority
rule: Spend above the delegated authority threshold must be decided by a human.

name: Supplier-line stop
rule: The fleet cannot stop a supplier line on its own.

name: Supply-architecture change
rule: Changing the supply architecture (e.g. activating a second source) is not autonomous.

name: Reversibility window
rule: Autonomous actions must be reversible for 24h and logged.

name: Dossier integrity
rule: A dossier shift must be checked against the Notified Body review window before proposal.
